NHAI uses dashcams to monitor 50,000 km of highways, automate contractor penalties

The National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) has implemented dashcam surveillance across 50,000 kilometers of national highways. This initiative aims to automate penalties for contractors responsible for highway maintenance and concessionaires. The system will monitor for defects such as potholes, faded road markings, rutting, and faulty lights, addressing recurring problems on highway stretches and preventing delays or evasion of action by contractors and NHAI officials.
